name: insights
description: Configuration insight and analysis - metrics, dependency graph, config comparison, query anti-patterns, health snapshot, impact analysis, object summary, database tables of an object, semantic metadata search. Operations: project_metrics, dependency_graph, compare_configurations, compare_three_way, detect_query_anti_patterns, generate_health_snapshot, impact_analysis, object_summary, describe_db_tables, semantic_metadata_search, help. Pass operation=<name> (snake_case canonical; camelCase like projectMetrics is also accepted); remaining parameters follow the per-operation contracts (call operation=help for the catalog, or operation=help topic=<operation> for one operation's parameters). Every operation reads only, except compare_three_way with an intent other than REPORT, which writes into the project and is refused under a preset without write rights. The standalone tools remain available for back-compat.

operation.description: project_metrics / dependency_graph / compare_configurations / compare_three_way / detect_query_anti_patterns / generate_health_snapshot / impact_analysis / object_summary / describe_db_tables / semantic_metadata_search / help (snake_case canonical; camelCase like projectMetrics is also accepted). operation=help topic=<operation> answers what that operation takes.

topic.description: Help topic when operation=help. Without topic - lists all operations with one-line summaries.

find.description: With help: search this help for a case-insensitive substring - all the words must appear inside one chunk, and with topic only that topic is searched.

projectName.description: EDT project name; compare_configurations mode=files: the path of the first export.

objectFqn.description: FQN of the object in question, e.g. 'Catalog.Products'.

scope.description: project_metrics: project / subsystem (default project). dependency_graph: project / subsystem / object / module. detect_query_anti_patterns: project / module / method (default project). compare_configurations: project / objectFqn (default project); objectFqn narrows the comparison to one object.

moduleFqn.description: Module FQN when scope=module (dependency_graph) or scope=module/method (detect_query_anti_patterns).

level.description: dependency_graph: metadata / modules / mixed (default metadata) - what the graph nodes are. compare_configurations: object / attribute / module / template (default object) - granularity of the diff; attribute needs mode=projects.

edgeKinds.description: dependency_graph: via values to keep, comma-separated or a JSON array. Omit - or pass an empty list - to keep every kind; the answer writes no edgeKinds field for an empty list.

maxNodes.description: dependency_graph: node cap, default 200, at most 2000.

maxEdges.description: dependency_graph: edge cap, default 500, at most 5000.

mode.description: compare_configurations: projects / files. Required for that operation. The answer's failed / failedCount name what the comparison could not read.

target.description: compare_configurations: for mode=projects, the second project's name; for mode=files, the path to the second export.

otherPath.description: compare_three_way: directory holding the configuration to compare against (OTHER).

showRenames.description: compare_configurations: detect renames via structural similarity (default true).

severity_filter.description: detect_query_anti_patterns: info / warning / error / all (default warning).

rules.description: detect_query_anti_patterns: comma-separated rule names (default all): SELECT_STAR, NO_WHERE_ON_LARGE_TABLE, VIRTUAL_TABLE_PARAMS, CROSS_JOIN_NO_CONDITION, NESTED_QUERY_DEPTH, SUBQUERY_IN_SELECT, QUERY_IN_LOOP.

includeAntiPatterns.description: generate_health_snapshot: include the anti-pattern scan, slower (default true).

includeMetrics.description: generate_health_snapshot: include LOC/methods/modules metrics, slower (default true).

includeMetadata.description: generate_health_snapshot: include metadata object counts per type (default true).

includeErrors.description: generate_health_snapshot: include the errors/warnings summary (default true). object_summary: run get_project_errors to count validation problems (default true).

action.description: impact_analysis: planned action - delete / rename / modify. Optional, influences the recommendation text only.

limit.description: impact_analysis: maximum references per category (default 100). semantic_metadata_search: maximum results (default 50).

skipBsl.description: impact_analysis: skip BSL code references, metadata back-references only (default false).

includeReferences.description: object_summary: run find_references (skipBsl=true) to count metadata back-references (default true).

includeFields.description: describe_db_tables: include the fields and virtual-table parameters (default true).

query.description: semantic_metadata_search: free-text query, matched case-insensitively against name, synonym and comment of every object.

metadataType.description: semantic_metadata_search: optional filter by type (English singular: Catalog / Document / InformationRegister / ... or Russian equivalent).

format.description: project_metrics, compare_configurations and detect_query_anti_patterns: json (default) or markdown. dependency_graph: json (default) / mermaid / plantuml / dot.

includeDebtList.description: project_metrics: include the detailed debt items list with file:line (default false).

ancestorPath.description: compare_three_way: directory holding the delivery both sides came from. Omit for a two-sided comparison.

parentId.description: compare_three_way: which vendor configuration of the project the deliveries are measured against, by id or by name.

decisions.description: compare_three_way: what to do with individual objects, as a JSON array of {"object":"...","rule":"..."}.

decisionsPath.description: compare_three_way: where to write the recorded decisions. Must end in .zip.

decisionsFrom.description: compare_three_way: a settings file (.zip) written earlier whose decisions and hand-made object correspondences are applied to this comparison.

intent.description: compare_three_way: REPORT (default) reads and changes nothing; MERGE applies the decisions to the project - IRREVERSIBLE; a restore point of the project files is taken first and git restore_merge_point puts them back without rolling back the infobase. MERGE_IGNORING_PROBLEMS proceeds past a problem the environment called blocking.

changedBy.description: compare_three_way: list only objects with this attribution - OURS, VENDOR, BOTH or UNKNOWN. The counts always cover everything; this narrows the listing.

type.description: compare_three_way: list only objects of this metadata type (Catalog, Document).

oneSided.description: compare_three_way: true lists only objects present on one side, false only those present on both.

mustBeMergedOnly.description: compare_three_way: list only objects the environment says must take part in a merge.

offset.description: compare_three_way: how many matching objects to skip.

sectionsOffset.description: compare_three_way: module pieces to skip in sections.

ignoreOriginMismatch.description: compare_three_way: compare the sides even when they do not identify as the same configuration in different versions.

report.description: compare_three_way: assemble the answer into one document - the sides, what moved and on whose side, what an update overwrites if nobody intervenes, the conflicts to decide by hand, the support state, and what the run did NOT check. summary or full.

methodLevel.description: compare_three_way: look inside modules, so a change comes back named by the method it is in - CommonModule.X.Module.MethodName - with its own attribution, and a decision can be addressed at one method without touching its neighbours.

closeSession.description: compare_three_way: close the comparison after answering instead of keeping it open for the next page.
